_comment: Settings for the watcher (claude-autoswitch.py), the cockpit and claude-swap. install.sh copies this to ~/.claude-profiles/autoswitch.json once and never overwrites it. Keys starting with _ are notes and are ignored. The file is re-read on every poll, so edits need no restart.
_enabled: Master switch for the watcher: alerts when the fleet account is nearly out. The cockpit's `a` key flips it. Does nothing unless you ran install_watcher.sh.
_swap_enabled: OFF by default. Turning this on allows the no-browser swap: claude-swap <name>, the cockpit number keys, and auto-swap. A swap MOVES login tokens between keychain items. Read docs/safety.md before setting it to true. It must be the JSON value true; the text "true" does not count.
_auto_swap: Armed for ONE automatic swap. Set it with `claude-autoswitch --arm`, not by hand. The watcher turns it back off itself before it swaps. Ignored while swap_enabled is false.
_exclude_from_auto: Profiles the watcher may never pick on its own. They stay available by hand. The key must exist, even as an empty list: the watcher refuses to run without it, so a typo cannot quietly make every account eligible.
_thresholds: Act once the fleet account's 5-hour OR weekly usage reaches switch_at_pct. A target must be under BOTH ceilings.
_pacing: poll_sec: how often the fleet is checked (a usage read, no inference). cooldown_min: minimum gap between alerts.
_notify: macOS notification on a switch and when every account is out.
